description: List a form's submissions, newest or oldest first, filtered by keyword, date range or specific field values. Set include_data to get the answers. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

data_format.description: Shape of data: legacy (object keyed by field id) or standardized (array of field objects).

encryption_password.description: Only for forms with encryption enabled: the form's encryption password, sent as the X-FS-Encryption-Password header.

expand_data.description: Include expanded field data with parsed values.

field_filters.description: Search specific fields by value (up to 10 criteria, AND-ed).

value.description: The value to search for in that field.

keyword.description: Match submissions by content across all fields.

max_time.description: Only entries created on or before this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

min_time.description: Only entries created on or after this date/time: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (Eastern Time).

pretty_name.description: Include a human-readable name per submission (from its name/email field).

name: formstack_list_form_submissions
title: List a form's submissions
